einzeiler: R&B singer Donnell Jones discusses his 30-year career, classic hits, and stories.
kurzfassung: R&B artist Donnell Jones joins the podcast to reflect on his 30-year career in the music industry. He shares origin stories from Chicago, working with Eddie F and LaFace Records, and writing hits like 'Where I Want to Be' and 'You Know What's Up.' Jones also discusses his future plans, current collaborations, and thoughts on the evolution of R&B.

beschreibung:
R&B legend Donell Jones joins the R&B Money Podcast for a conversation about the songs, stories, and life behind a catalog that helped define an era.

From “Where I Wanna Be” and “U Know What’s Up” to “You Know That I Love You,” Donell takes us back to the records that made him one of the signature voices of late-'90s and 2000s R&B. He shares stories from his journey into the music business, developing his sound as a singer, songwriter, and producer, and creating music that continues to resonate more than two decades later.

Donell also speaks on Verzuz, the conversations surrounding R&B matchups and catalogs, and where he sees himself among the artists from his generation. He gets into the realities of longevity, navigating the highs and lows of the industry, and the personal growth that came with surviving it all.

The conversation also explores songwriting, relationships, independence, the evolution of R&B, and what Donell is working on today.
